# mtncloud_load_balancer (Data Source)

Looks up one load balancer by ID or by name, including one made in the console. A load balancer spreads traffic across instances. A name must match exactly one load balancer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# By name (matched exactly); `id = 123` works too.
data "mtncloud_load_balancer" "example" {
  name = "web-lb"
}

output "load_balancer_external_ip" {
  value = data.mtncloud_load_balancer.example.external_ip
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) ID of the load balancer. Give this or `name`.
- `name` (String) Name of the load balancer, matched exactly. Give this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `cloud` (String) Cloud the load balancer is in.
- `description` (String) Description, or empty.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the load balancer is enabled.
- `external_ip` (String) External (public) IP, or empty.
- `host` (String) Host name or address, or empty.
- `internal_ip` (String) Internal IP, or empty.
- `ip` (String) Address, or empty.
- `port` (Number) Port, or 0.
- `ssl_enabled` (Boolean) Whether SSL is enabled.
- `type` (String) Load balancer type.
- `visibility` (String) `private` or `public`.
